name: Tesofensine

protocolDosing.notes: t½ ~9 days (220 h) — significant accumulation; 2–3 weeks to steady state; 0.5 mg/day = ~10.6% placebo-corrected weight loss at 24 weeks; 1.0 mg dose abandoned (excess CV effects); approved in Mexico as Tesomet (with metoprolol)

effects: increased heart rate (dose-dependent, ~8 bpm at 0.5 mg)

mechanismOfAction.summary: Triple monoamine reuptake inhibitor (dopamine + norepinephrine + serotonin); phenyltropane scaffold.
mechanismOfAction.description: SNDRI; inhibits DAT, NET, and SERT → appetite suppression via hypothalamic circuits. Possible GLP-1 pathway potentiation. Active metabolite M1 via CYP3A4. t½ ~9 days (220 h) — extremely long, requires weeks to reach steady state; dose titration essential. Approved in Mexico as Tesomet (tesofensine + metoprolol 25 mg to offset HR increase). WADA S6 in-competition.
